SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
  AND d.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_week

WITH period2_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date
)
SELECT 
  ps_current.fiscal_week,
  ps_current.fiscal_week_start_date,
  ROUND(ps_current.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2026_27,
  ROUND(ps_prior.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(((ps_current.net_sales - ps_prior.net_sales) / ps_prior.net_sales) * 100, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM period2_sales ps_current
LEFT JOIN period2_sales ps_prior 
  ON ps_current.fiscal_week = ps_prior.fiscal_week 
  AND ps_prior.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ps_current.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ps_current.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_week,
  fiscal_week_start_date,
  fiscal_week_end_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT calendar_date) AS days_in_week
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
  AND fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_week

WITH period2_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    SUM(rpt.net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rpt
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON rpt.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date
)
SELECT 
  ps_current.fiscal_week,
  ps_current.fiscal_week_start_date,
  ROUND(ps_current.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2026_27,
  ROUND(ps_prior.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(((ps_current.net_sales - ps_prior.net_sales) / ps_prior.net_sales) * 100, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM period2_sales ps_current
LEFT JOIN period2_sales ps_prior 
  ON ps_current.fiscal_week = ps_prior.fiscal_week 
  AND ps_prior.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ps_current.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ps_current.fiscal_week

WITH period2_by_channel AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    fsl.channel_code,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, fsl.channel_code
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, channel_code, ROUND(net_amount, 2) as net_amount
FROM period2_by_channel
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_week, channel_code

SELECT 
  d.calendar_date,
  d.fiscal_week,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.sales_line_id) AS sales_lines,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS fsl_net_amount,
  rpt.net_sales AS rpt_net_sales
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON d.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales rpt ON d.calendar_date = rpt.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  AND d.fiscal_week = 5
GROUP BY d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_week, rpt.net_sales
ORDER BY d.calendar_date

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  SUM(rpt.net_sales) AS net_sales_sum
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rpt
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON rpt.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  AND d.fiscal_week = 5
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
